sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; as per policy schedule

room_rent.note: Room category and rent limit are specified in the policy schedule, not in the wording itself. Proportional deduction applies if a higher room is availed.

icu.note: ICU/CCU/HDU charges covered; specific limits as per policy schedule.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base policy. Optional co-pay (Basic Benefit Option 3.3.6) gives premium discount. Co-pay also triggered if First Notification (3.3.4) or Preferred Provider Network (3.3.5) conditions are breached. Percentage as per schedule.

sub_limits.note: Wording does not specify disease-wise sub-limits; sub-limits may be applied per schedule or underwriting conditions.

deductible.note: No deductible in base policy. Optional Super Top-up (3.3.7) introduces an aggregate deductible as per schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period (Excl03). Can be waived via optional Basic Benefit Option 3.3.13 at inception.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as per Excl01; number of months specified in policy schedule (standard is 36 months per definition).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease/procedure waiting period (Excl02) up to 24 months. Can be reduced via optional Basic Benefit Option 3.3.10.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy for in-patient only is covered. No maternity add-on offered in this wording.

cumulative_bonus.note: NCB Sum Insured (Basic Benefit Option 3.3.3) is optional. Rate per year as per schedule; NCB cannot exceed base SI in any policy year. Must be opted.

restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured (Basic Benefit Option 3.3.2) is optional. Restores full SI unlimited times but NOT for the same illness for which a claim was already made in the current policy year.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover is a basic benefit (3.2.4); number of days specified in policy schedule, not in wording.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover is a basic benefit (3.2.4); number of days specified in policy schedule, not in wording.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment is a basic benefit (3.2.3).

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization is a basic benefit (3.2.7); must continue for at least 3 consecutive days; reimbursement basis only.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered as basic benefit (3.2.10). OPD AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor in-patient hospitalization expenses covered as basic benefit (3.2.8). Pre/post-hosp of donor, donor screening, organ acquisition costs excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable/actual costs (3.2.5); no fixed cap stated in wording. Domestic emergency evacuation also covered (3.2.6).

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed in 3.2.11 covered as basic benefit including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: Non-payable/consumable expenses (Annexure 1) excluded by default. Optional Basic Benefit Option 3.3.8 (Waiver of non-payable expenses) covers them if opted.

global_cover.note: Worldwide in-patient hospitalization (Basic Benefit Option 3.3.1) is optional. Base policy covers India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for renewal. For instalment premiums: 15 days for monthly, 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period at inception only; not applicable on renewals or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; application must be received at least 30 days before renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, STDs (non-HIV), sleep disorders, hormone therapy, external congenital anomaly, substance abuse, hazardous sports (professional), RF ablation, tobacco-related cancers

optional_riders.display: Worldwide cover, Restore SI, NCB SI, Super Top-up, Co-pay, Waiver of non-payables, All medically necessary hosp, OPD cover, Daily hospital cash, Accidental death/disability, Inflation protect SI, 30-day waiver, Specific illness waiting period reduction
